# SafeStorage

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/381e87005f49e132cc7df5b7b0fc90224415b97c/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/libraries/SafeStorage.sol)

**Title:** SafeStorage - Storage layout of the Safe contracts to be used in libraries.

**Author:** Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

<i>

Should be always the first base contract of a library that is used with a Safe.

</i>

## State Variables

### singleton

```solidity
address internal singleton;
```

### modules

```solidity
mapping(address => address) internal modules;
```

### owners

```solidity
mapping(address => address) internal owners;
```

### ownerCount

```solidity
uint256 internal ownerCount;
```

### threshold

```solidity
uint256 internal threshold;
```

### nonce

```solidity
uint256 internal nonce;
```

### _deprecatedDomainSeparator

```solidity
bytes32 internal _deprecatedDomainSeparator;
```

### signedMessages

```solidity
mapping(bytes32 => uint256) internal signedMessages;
```

### approvedHashes

```solidity
mapping(address => mapping(bytes32 => uint256)) internal approvedHashes;
```
